name: @bharatchain/indexer
description: The Graph subgraph for BharatChain (public on-chain welfare ledger)

scripts.build: echo "(indexer: run 'npm run subgraph:deploy -w @bharatchain/indexer' against a running stack)" && exit 0
scripts.subgraph:build: npm run codegen && graph build --network hardhat
scripts.subgraph:deploy: npm run subgraph:build && (graph create bharatchain/welfare --node http://localhost:8020/ || echo already-created) && graph deploy bharatchain/welfare --node http://localhost:8020/ --ipfs http://localhost:5001/ --version-label v0.0.1
